sections.title: Wheat genus
sections.text: Triticum comprises annual grasses cultivated as wheat. Stems bear narrow leaves and a terminal spike made of sessile spikelets; each spikelet contains several florets and develops grain. Height and awns vary widely among species and crop varieties, so a single measurement does not describe the genus.

sections.title: Grain and food
sections.text: Wheat grain is a dry one-seeded fruit (caryopsis) and a major cereal food. Wheat contains gluten, which people with coeliac disease must avoid. The plate is a representative wheat ear, not an identification of one Triticum species.
